scope: Round-1 credential rotation/revocation and landing-page shutdown

source_release_secret_gate.scope_limit: all local refs; remote or unfetched refs are not claimed
source_release_secret_gate.release_requirement: rerun at a clean frozen commit

github_actions_secret_bindings.impact: Private cross-repository CI and auto-bump jobs remain intentionally disabled until a new least-privilege credential is installed or public-source dependencies remove the need.

release_blockers: The owner of the underlying GitHub personal access token must revoke it in GitHub settings; deleting repository bindings does not prove token revocation.
A replacement least-privilege CI credential or a public-dependency workflow design is required before private cross-repository workflows can pass.
The development-worktree source gate passed, but source-release and evidence scans must pass again at a clean frozen commit.
Remote services must receive the rotated values and pass a deployment smoke before any availability claim.
